1_session_id_vs_correlation_id.description: Proxy for distinct real session vs current bug where session_id == correlation_id (both usually null pre-fix).
1_session_id_vs_correlation_id.caveat: correlation_id was not populated on ANY of the sampled traces (0/100). All 'differ' cases are session_id-present/correlation_id-null, not two genuinely distinct populated IDs.

4_approx_conversation_grouping.method: cluster by metadata.session_id (fallback top-level session_id), chained timestamp gaps <= 10 min
4_approx_conversation_grouping.note: session_id is null/absent on nearly all pre-fix traces, so this grouping is expected to find few/no real multi-trace sessions. That itself is a baseline finding.
